title: 第1章 从手术台到乱葬岗第2章 第一台异界手术
lines: 无影灯的冷光如手术刀般切割着视野，监护仪的蜂鸣声在耳畔拉扯成连绵不绝的长音。
林澈感到自己的意识正进行混沌状态，仿佛混浊的泥浆满脑海晃荡，就连视线都模糊不清了。
整个身躯像在云端飘浮。
四十八小时连轴转。
三台高危器官移植，最后一台是给一个八岁女孩换肝——肿瘤已经扩散到膈肌，剥离时大出血，血压一度降到测不出。
“林主任！
坚持住！”
“肾上腺素1mg静脉推注！”
“准备除颤！”
同事们的声音变得遥远，像来自天边的地平线。
林澈最后的清醒时刻在想：那孩子的肿瘤边缘……切干净了吗？病理报告要等三天，可肝脏离体时间不能超过……
黑暗吞噬了一切。
再睁开眼时，看到铅灰色的天空。
林澈的第一反应是：术后监护室换地方了？然后剧痛如潮水般涌来——不是手术后的虚弱疼痛，是实实在在的、骨头断裂、内脏破裂的撕裂痛。
他躺在泥地里，身下是湿冷粘稠的腐殖质。
空气中弥漫着复杂的气味：腐肉、铁锈、某种刺鼻的草药，还有……粪便。
远处传来乌鸦嘶哑的啼叫，翅膀扑棱声在死寂中唯一听到的声响。
专业诊断在脑内自动生成，速度快得让林澈自己都惊讶：
——右侧第三、四、五肋骨骨折，第四肋骨疑似刺入肺叶，呼吸时左侧胸痛伴皮下捻发感（气胸可能）。
——左侧胫骨中段开放性骨折，断端刺破皮肤，污染严重。
——腹壁紧张，肝区叩击痛阳性，腹腔内出血可能性大。
——全身多处软组织挫裂伤，失血量预估800-1000ml。
——体温偏低，脉搏细速，已进入失血性休克早期。
“伤成这样还能活着？”
林澈喃喃自语，他对自己的声音感到陌生。
这不是他的声音。
他四十岁，这声音听起来像二十岁不到的少年。
他艰难地抬起还能动的左手。
手很脏，指甲缝里塞满黑泥，但骨节分明，皮肤虽然粗糙，也布满老茧，却明显年轻。
手臂上有几道疤痕，像是刀伤愈合后留下的。
记忆碎片如冰锥般刺入脑海：
林澈，十七岁，青云门外门弟子，炼气期三层。
孤儿，八岁被测出资质低劣，勉强收入外门做杂役。
三天前，内门师兄周震丢失一瓶聚气丹，有杂役指证看见林澈在丹房附近徘徊。
没有证据，但周震是外门执事的侄子。
于是，林澈被打断筋骨，废去微末修为，扔到乱葬岗自生自灭。
真正的林澈已经死了，在寒冷、疼痛和绝望中咽下了最后一口气。
而现在占据这具身体的，是来自二十一世纪，刚在手术台上猝死的顶尖外科专家，林澈。

The cold light of the shadowless lamp cut through the field of vision like a scalpel, and the beeping sound of the monitor became a long and continuous sound in my ears.
Lin Che felt that her consciousness was entering a state of chaos, as if turbid mud was filling her mind, and even her vision was blurred.
The whole body seemed to be floating in the clouds.
Forty-eight hours of continuous rotation.
Three high-risk organ transplants, the last one was a liver transplant for an eight-year-old girl - the tumor had spread to the diaphragm, there was massive bleeding during the removal, and the blood pressure once dropped to undetectable.
"Director Lin!
Hang in there! "
"Epinephrine 1mg intravenous injection!"
"Prepare for defibrillation!"
The voices of colleagues became distant, like coming from the horizon.
In her last conscious moments, Lin Che was thinking: Has the edge of the child's tumor... been removed cleanly? The pathology report has to wait three days, but the liver cannot be separated from the body for longer than...
Darkness swallowed everything.
When I opened my eyes again, I saw the leaden sky.
Lin Che's first reaction was: Has the post-operative intensive care unit been moved to another location? Then the pain came flooding in—not the debilitating pain of post-surgery, but the actual, tearing pain of broken bones and ruptured internal organs.
He lay in the mud, covered in clammy and sticky humus.
The air was filled with a complex smell: carrion, rust, some kind of pungent herb, and... feces.
The hoarse crow of a crow could be heard in the distance, and the flapping of wings was the only sound heard in the dead silence.
The professional diagnosis was automatically generated in her brain at a speed that surprised Lin Che herself:
——The third, fourth, and fifth ribs on the right side were fractured, and the fourth rib was suspected of piercing the lung lobe. Chest pain on the left side with subcutaneous twisting sensation during breathing (possible pneumothorax).
——An open fracture in the middle part of the left tibia, the broken end pierced the skin and was seriously contaminated.
——Abdominal wall tension, percussion pain in the liver area is positive, and intra-abdominal bleeding is likely.
——Multiple soft tissue contusions and lacerations throughout the body, and the blood loss is estimated to be 800-1000ml.
——The body temperature is low, the pulse is thin and fast, and he has entered the early stage of hemorrhagic shock.
"Can you still survive after being injured like this?"
Lin Che murmured to herself, his own voice felt strange to him.
This is not his voice.
He was forty years old, and his voice sounded like that of a boy under twenty.
He raised his left hand with difficulty.
The hands were dirty, and the nails were filled with black mud, but the joints were distinct. Although the skin was rough and covered with calluses, it was obviously young.
There were a few scars on his arms, like those left after a knife wound had healed.
Memory fragments pierce into my mind like ice picks:
Lin Che, seventeen years old, an outer disciple of Qingyun Sect, third level of Qi refining stage.
An orphan, he was found to have low qualifications at the age of eight and was forced to work outside as a handyman.
Three days ago, inner disciple Zhou Zhen lost a bottle of Qi Gathering Pill, and a handyman testified that he saw Lin Che wandering near the pill room.
There is no evidence, but Zhou Zhen is the nephew of the deacon of the outer sect.
As a result, Lin Che's muscles and bones were broken, her minimal cultivation was wasted, and she was thrown into a mass grave to fend for herself.
The real Lin Che was dead, having breathed her last in cold, pain and despair.
The person occupying this body now is Lin Che, a top surgical expert from the 21st century who just died suddenly on the operating table.
title_en: Chapter 1 From the Operating Table to the Mass Grave Chapter 2 The First Extraterrestrial Surgery
